description:
OTP's :lists.foldl guard 'when is_function(F, 2)' makes Enum.reduce's reducer cross the boxed seam: Enum.each over a list builds two construction wrappers where it built none, and the distiller costs +11.8% requests. Without the guard, every count falls. Found by fz-mue.44's builder (Elixir Parity). Evidence: the mue.44 report; probes in Elixir Parity's scratchpad distill_{base,a,b}.log; tests compiler2_never_boxed_discarded_closure_call_delivers_no_lanes and compiler2_no_value_reaches_a_construction_member_that_never_named_it.

A type test is a question about the value, not a use of it; it should not by itself demand a boxed callable (the boxed apply wrapper is the sole boxing seam, used only when proven necessary).

Blocks fz-mue.44, which the user chose to park on this (2026-11-20, relayed by Elixir Parity). Owner: Callables. Related: the is_function arity ticket fz-yh5.7.
title: An is_function(f, n) guard does not force a callable through the boxed seam (option A: guard-domain table)
